node.statement: Correction of the false finite-dimensional sentence: write h=(Ha^Q_{P,P})_1 and let q be the Hilbert norm from the Ha definition on S_{P,Q}. Unpacking the registered O(e) statements in def-ha-map, compressed-product-display, epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms, nonvanishing-delta-projection, and one-dimensional-projection-nonvanishing, there are universal e_0>0, K_dot<infinity, c_q>0, and c_u>0 such that for e<=e_0: ||A dot B||<=K_dot||A||||B|| for every compatible level-one product, c_q^{-1}||X||<=q(X)<=c_q||X|| on S_{P,Q}, and ||u_Q||>=c_u. (Q is nonvanishing because it is one-dimensional.) We may replace e_sq by min(e_sq,e_0), without weakening node 1.1 or changing the form of the final universal threshold.
